contract_gates.note: This repository uses the reduced contract framework; the frozen index, manual SHA comparison, source-closure manifest, and common checker form the traceability gate.

requirement_results.requirement: MM2S and S2MM local_offset[31:23] reject before request/acquire
GEMM bank-only input address and compatibility output base equal zero
response effects only on valid && ready and offered request remains stable while response is stalled
DMA success retires matching pending command and releases exact owner
descriptor error codes 01 through 06 retire/release and propagate exact code
transport codes 10/20/30/40/50 retain pending/ownership without release until reset
unknown codes and error=1/code=00 fail closed with retained ownership
mismatched DMA response and GEMM tuple never release, then matching response drains
active reset recovery, repeat execution, and END pending drain
fresh isolated 5 ns Vivado OOC with exact part, no black boxes, timing/resource/DRC/methodology reports

simulation.launcher_note: The environment-specific Tcl launcher limitation was avoided by driving the freshly elaborated xsimk snapshot directly; compile and elaboration logs are retained.

allowed_warning_classes.UNUSED: frozen compatibility input and reserved instruction fields

findings.finding: The frozen module_index binds the contract and dependencies but does not directly contain the sparse_isa_dispatcher RTL SHA or a source-manifest SHA.
findings.impact: The index hash alone cannot identify a later-mutated RTL file. This exact audit remains source-bound by the independently computed RTL SHA and source_closure.sha256, so it is not a blocker for promotion of only that exact RTL identity.
findings.recommendation: On the next authorized index revision, add rtl_sha256 or source_manifest_sha256; any RTL change from 9305b7f5... requires fresh verification.

promotion.scope: module-level promotion of exact RTL SHA 9305b7f5b104c2a1373f718272ce8db3eacced8b1dcff97f7690d78de72b2569 as a bounded infrastructure dispatcher
promotion.condition: consumer must connect both 8-bit DMA status-code ports and preserve coherent reset/ownership recovery

residual_risks: Transport/recovery faults intentionally keep busy asserted in ERROR_DRAIN until a coordinated reset clears retained pending and ownership state.
Simultaneous multiple executor responses and mismatched identities carrying a transport-class code are conservatively fail-closed but do not have an explicit priority contract beyond the present RTL.
OOC timing is post-synthesis module evidence, not routed integration timing.
